mode.description: ask: ask before changes; auto: changes inside the working directory and harmless commands go through; plan: change nothing, present a plan; readonly: change nothing; yolo: never ask

askTimeoutMinutes.description: how long to wait for an answer to an approval question before denying the call (at most 10080, one week)

review.description: in auto mode, let the model review the calls the rules cannot decide: it allows them or blocks them and tells the agent to ask you first; false turns the review off, and those calls ask you instead

reviewModel.description: the name of a model saved with /model that runs the auto-mode review instead of the current model; a fast, cheap one is enough, and it has its own rate limit
